title: btle: Refactor to reduce scope of variables
description:
The function `dissect_btle()` is very very long.
This merge request does some refactoring that removes the scope of some of the variables inside this function.
That should make it easier to do further changes later.

Regarding CRC could the existing wireshark\wsutil\crc32.c be used/extended? We are looking at performance enhancment to CRC calculations.

I believe the CRC calculations done for Bluetooth LE is slightly different than what can be found in crc32. The initial difference is that the CRC is 3 bytes instead of 4.

The exact CRC algorithm is explained in the Bluetooth Core specification, Vol 6, Part B, Section 3.1.1.

commits_data.title: btle: Extract out function obtaining btle_context
commits_data.message:
btle: Extract out function obtaining btle_context

By extracting out this function we reduce the scope of some
of the variables used in dissect_btle() which will make further
refactoring simpler.

commits_data.title: btle: Dissect CRC in one place only
commits_data.message:
btle: Dissect CRC in one place only

Previously the CRC was checked or calculated in multiple places.
Moving everything to one function may make it more maintainable.

commits_data.title: btle: Remove btle_context_t::connection_info
commits_data.message:
btle: Remove btle_context_t::connection_info

The previously used crc_init is not stored in
connection_info_t.

The btle dissector is now dissecting different types of
contexts. Previously it was only dissecting ACL connections
that could be established using a LL_CONNECT_IND only.
Now this is no longer the case.

This code change will allow us to cleanup up CRC calculation
code.
